claims.claim_ar: الفعل «قَالُوا» يعمل كأداة لعرض القول المقلوب/نقل كلام الآخرين، أي إدراج المقولة كطريقة بلاغية لبيان موقف القائلين وتوضيح تفاعل الجماعة مع الحدث.
claims.claim_en: The verb «قَالُوا» functions as a device for presenting reported speech — inserting others' utterance as a rhetorical means to show the speakers' stance and their reaction.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Frames the following clause as a reported response, distancing the speaker and foregrounding the collective stance of those who speak.

claims.claim_ar: حرف الجر «إِلَى» يحدد جهةَ العَوْدة/الانتقال ويقيد مدلول العودة بمقصودٍ معيّن (هنا: العودة إلى الربّ)، وهو أسلوب بلاغي لتقريب المعنى وتحديده.
claims.claim_en: The preposition «إِلَى» specifies the direction/return and restricts the notion of return to a particular destination (here: returning to the Lord). This is a rhetorical means to focus and limit the meaning.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source substring is from a different verse context ('إِلى ثَمُودَ'); mapping the general prepositional function to the specific rhetorical category (hasr/qasr) in this ayah may require review by a specialist.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Narrows the scope of 'return' to a defined locus (the Lord), intensifying the sense of finality and accountability.
